name: claude-code
description: Delegate coding tasks to Claude Code as a subagent, using your own Claude subscription login or Anthropic API key
shortDescription: Run Claude Code as a subagent

setup.notice: Runs the unmodified Claude Code CLI with your own Anthropic account and requires Node.js 22 or later. Not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
steps: To use a Claude subscription, leave the API key empty and run `claude auth login` on the machine where the session runs. The plugin never reads or stores that login.
